capability: C = 'the word before the trigger already occurred earlier in the window' (window positions 0-18, the word at 19, the trigger at 20). Two-valued, not fixed by the word's token type (every word occurs in both classes), with an answer defined for words the fine-tune never saw: E116's readable shape (reports/analyses/2026-11-06_analysis_e116-definition-table.md, 'What this means for step 2').

settings_sources.everything E112 has: experiments/case_label/results/predictions.json, unchanged: probe rows, label candidates and seeds, window counts (train 9,600 from rows with index mod 5 != 0; fit 1,024 and held-out 1,600 from rows with index mod 5 == 0), the ridge probe (lambda 1e-3, cap 16 per class per word, read as score > 0.5), the Hewitt-Liang control, the fine-tune recipe (E62's arm A: Adam 3e-5, batch 32, KL 1, clip 1, all 24 matrices, target data.LAST, checkpoints 10-1000, stop at the first checkpoint with fit accuracy >= 0.9), the random direction (seed 5), pruning and reverse fine-tuning.
settings_sources.pool: plan: single tokens of a space then letters (E112's word test) with at least 32 Pile positions in each class (word with / without an earlier occurrence in the 19 tokens before it, on the probe rows; 32 = twice the probe cap) and an earlier-occurrence share of at most 0.5 (one that nearly always repeats cannot fill clean 'not repeated' windows); the marker and the label candidates out. 400 drawn seeded from the qualifying words, the first 300 train, the last 100 held out. Drawn, not ranked: a ranking by count gave a pool led by function words (' of', ' to', ' and', CPU dry run 2026-11-06, App. §1).
settings_sources.windows: plan: E112's layout (keydep.vocab's rows 0-32767 and marker, the word at 19, the trigger at 20). A window's Pile span is the first of 16 seeded draws with the word nowhere in positions 0-18; one position p in 1-17 is then overwritten, with the word itself (repeated, y = 1) or another pool word (not repeated, y = 0), so both classes carry one written pool word before the word. Classes alternate within a word.
settings_sources.control (Hewitt-Liang): case_label.control_table (E116's per-type form): one seeded random value per token type; the probe is fit on the Pile windows' word types and scored on the held-out words' types. Since every word has both classes in equal number, a type-level readout scores about 0.5.
settings_sources.decomposition: E119 (experiments/teacher_route_split/results/predictions.json config): route lines r_hi 0.6, r_lo 0.35, masked_hi 0.5, masked_lo 0.25 (E12's P4 and E12 Amendment 1's P3), min_ratio 0.5, zero_tol 1e-6; student lr 1e-5, 1,000 steps, batch 32 (E34's arm A). E38 Amendment 2 (experiments/recruitment_test/results/predictions_amend2.json, src/commute/recruitment.py constants): S threshold 0.3 (E18's THR), 20 random sets, the trigger-only rule, D_THROUGH 0.10, D_NOT 0.05, 18 of 20, empty-set tolerance 1e-5 (its C3), min gain 1 nat.
settings_sources.route windows: plan: the first 256 fit windows (training words), each task's own label as the per-window target. The fit windows are where both arms perform what they learned (the twin is at chance on held-out words) and where E112's P3 reads; E119 read 73-103 windows.
settings_sources.time: each stage is one debug job (30-min limit); stage_minutes 25 is the time check; stage 1 exits 3 before a fine-tune or before the reads, and stage 2 before a student, when less than finetune_minutes / student_minutes would be left. Recorded states are kept.

decomposition.route_label_rule: E119's, quoted: 'unreadable' if r or e_gate is not finite, gain < 1 nat (MIN_GAIN), or gain / teacher's gain < 0.5 (a zero or negative teacher gain is unreadable); else 're-switching' if r >= 0.6 and e_gate <= 0.25; else 'masked-off' if e_gate >= 0.5 and r <= 0.35; else 'neither'. The fine-tune's own reading is its least-squares split with its own gain as the teacher's.
decomposition.removal_rule: E38 Amendment 2's P5 seed rule, quoted: "'through' if D(S) >= 0.10 and D(S) exceeds all 20 random D; 'not' if D(S) < 0.05 or D(S) exceeds fewer than 18 of the 20 random D; else 'unclear'" (recruitment.d_seed_class); a state with G < 1 nat is 'unscored: gain < 1 nat', and one with S empty 'unscored: S is empty' (nothing to remove; reported, not a new rule).
decomposition.no_joining_rule: No rule joins the decomposition labels to the definition's verdicts; the plan's joint-outcome table says what each combination would mean, and stage 2's summary prints the four labels side by side.

measurements.label: y = 1 for label A ('repeated'), 0 for B. d = logit A - logit B at the trigger; the model says A when d > 0; margin m = d signed toward the window's own label.
measurements.induction_gap: Positive control at W0, no rule: log P(the token after p) at the word's position 19, mean over repeated windows minus mean over not-repeated ones, on the fit and held-out windows. The model's induction circuit (E62/E97: heads at block 2) predicts that token only when the word occurred at p, so the gap says the model treats the written repeats as repeats.
measurements.P0: Possession at W0, per block l = 0-3: accuracy of the repeat probe on the held-out-word task windows at the trigger; selectivity = that minus the control probe's accuracy. l* = the earliest block before the last with accuracy >= 0.90 and selectivity >= 0.30 (inclusive). Beside, no rule: the same probe read at the word's own position.
measurements.P1: Held-out carrying (row 87): the state's label accuracy on the held-out-word windows (1,600).
measurements.P2: Small function (Def 2): g = a threshold and sign on W0's probe score at l*, fitted to the state's own labels on the fit windows (1,024); P2 = g's agreement with the state's labels on the held-out windows.
measurements.P3: Removal (row 81's added sentence, E112 stage 2's form): G = mean(m_state - m_W0) on the fit windows of the state's own task; share = mean(m_state - m_state with the probe's unit direction removed from block l*'s output residual at the trigger only) / G.
measurements.do_nothing: The same share with a seeded random unit direction, on every state, read first and alone: <= 0.10 on every state, else stage 1 stops and no state is read.
measurements.route split: local_faith.route_split at the trigger on the 256 route windows, target = the window's own label token (data.LAST, ci_len 41), quantity mean full-vocabulary log-odds of that token. Held fixed: Gamma, Delta, windows, released components. Varied: target weights and components. r = (L01 - L00) / gain, e_gate = ((U1 - L11) - (U0 - L00)) / gain.
measurements.copy: E34's arm-A student of each state (Adam 1e-5 on the alive U, V from 0, loss KL(teacher || student) on the training windows, 1,000 steps, batch 32), read by the route split on its own state (target W0 + the student's change, components its U', V'). Beside: its label agreement with its teacher on the held-out windows, gain ratio, fit accuracy.
measurements.removal: E38 Amendment 2, trigger-only: S = alive subcomponents whose mean trigger gate over the first 2,048 training windows rises by more than 0.3; rho_ft(X) = (T1 - lo(W1 without X)) / G, rho_0(X) = (T0 - lo(W0 without X)) / G, D = rho_ft - rho_0, for S and 20 size-matched random sets, on the route windows.

verdict_rule: E112's, unchanged: possession fails (l* is None) -> 'unreadable' on every state (stage 0 stops; the job reports 'possession fails'). Possession passes and P1 >= 0.90, P2 >= 0.90 and P3 >= 0.50 (inclusive) -> 'reuses C'; any of P1-P3 misses -> 'not through C' (a state that did not learn, a no-gain P3, and a number between the real bar and the twin expectation all read so). The same rule reads every state.

stage 0.w0_heldout_accuracy: about 0.5 on both tasks (0.40-0.60): the label words are unrelated to the windows (E112: 0.521 / 0.497)
stage 0.induction_gap: positive on fit and held-out windows, about 1 nat or more (lean, medium: E62/E97 found induction heads at block 2; no number exists for these windows). Zero or negative would say the model does not read the written repeats.
stage 0.P0: passes at block 1 or 2, accuracy 0.90-0.97, control 0.45-0.55 (lean, low-medium, about even odds: no 67M readout of a contextual property has been measured; the copying readout failed over 178 values, but this one is two-valued). A miss at every block is the filed result 'possession fails'.
stage 0.beside_acc_at_word: at or above the trigger's accuracy at each block (the flag is computed at the word first; lean, low)
stage 0.w0_removal: next-token loss change at the trigger under 0.05 nats for both directions (E112: 0.003 / 0.001)

stage 1.real step: the bar by step 100 or 300 (lean, medium; E112's real arm took 30 steps on a readout of 0.99)
stage 1.real: P1 >= 0.90, P2 >= 0.90, P3 >= 0.50 -> 'reuses C' (lean, low, about one in three for P3; the reason for any hope is that the flag is not part of the word's identity, unlike case, so the fine-tune cannot read it from many token-identity directions as E112's case could; the reason against is E112's 0.08 at the same rank-1, one-site removal)
stage 1.norms: twin's summed update norm 2-3x the real's (E112: 13.3 / 12.6 against 4.6 / 4.7)

stage 2.control_e12_amend1: copy students re-switching (4), maps masked-off (4), from file (E119's dry run)
stage 2.do-nothing: e_gate = -r and least-squares r = do-nothing r to 1e-6; r 0.45-0.65 on all four states, real and twin within 0.15 of each other (lean, medium: E119's trigger tasks read 0.49-0.61; r follows the task and the trigger more than the update, docs/research_log/parts/sections/claims.html)
stage 2.least-squares: e_gate 0.05-0.45 (a guess); label 'neither' on all four (lean, medium)
stage 2.copy: gain ratio 0.9-1.05; r within 0.06 of its fine-tune's; agreement with its teacher >= 0.90; label 'neither' (E119: all six arm-A students 'neither')
stage 2.removal: |S| > 0 on all four (lean, medium); empty-set change 0 to 1e-5; class 'not' or 'unclear' on both arms, D(S) real > twin (lean, low; E38 A2 read D(S) +0.12 to +0.26 with random max <= 0.15 on two trigger tasks, no label task)

filed_outcome.decomposition: route 'neither' on all four states, fine-tune and copy alike; removal 'not' or 'unclear'

stop_rules.stage 0: a window whose earlier count of its word is not its class: assert (the builder is wrong); P0 misses at every block before the last: exit 1, 'possession fails', stages 1 and 2 do not run
stop_rules.stage 1: the random direction's share over 0.10 on any state: exit 1, no state is read (E112)
stop_rules.stage 2: do-nothing e_gate + r over 1e-6, least-squares r minus do-nothing r over 1e-6 (E119); the empty-set removal's change over 1e-5 (E38 A2's C3): exit 1. A saved update whose sha256 differs from stage 1's record: assert.
stop_rules.later: none: an unreadable label is reported as such; a miss is a result

edge_cases.did not learn: the scored step is 1000 (learned false); P1-P3 read as filed; the verdict is then 'not through C' unless all three meet their bars.
edge_cases.no gain: G <= 0.1 nats: P3 nan, P3_no_gain true, verdict 'not through C'; its do-nothing share is no reading and does not stop stage 1.
edge_cases.do-nothing sign: share <= 0.10, not |share|: a negative share passes.
edge_cases.g with one class: theta -inf and the constant label; P2 = the share of held-out windows with that label.
edge_cases.do-nothing update (delta-W = 0) under th: P1 = W0's accuracy, about 0.5 < 0.90: 'not through C'; it cannot reach 'reuses C'. Under the route rule: gain 0 < 1 nat, 'unreadable'. Under the removal rule: G 0 < 1, 'unscored'.
edge_cases.S empty: random_like of an empty set is empty, so D would be 0 and d_seed_class would say 'not'; decomp_reads reports 'unscored: S is empty' instead (nothing to remove), as E38 reported lowercase and the ciphers (TRIED.md, E38 rows).
edge_cases.ties: every bar is inclusive, as E112 and E119 file them.

joint_outcomes: Plan, section 'What each joint outcome means'. Positive agreement = the definition reads 'reuses C' on both real seeds and 'not through C' on both twins, and a decomposition reading labels the real fine-tunes re-switching (route, fine-tune or copy) or 'through' (removal) while the twins read otherwise. No rule is added; the table is read by eye from stage 2's summary.
